lessons_used: Predictions were overall too optimistic compared to noise-corrected results.
Path selection hints (choose_path, hint) consistently improved conversion, winning in both tests.
Adoption stage redesigns (3 tests) and path selection layout changes (2 tests) failed to improve conversion, with larger redesigns hurting performance.
Home wait_info changes (3 tests), sign-in reordering (2 tests), finish notifications (2 tests), finish hints (2 tests), and home notifications (2 tests) showed no clear effect.

Evidence remains thin for single-test categories and categories without consistent agreement, including adoption layout/new_screen, choose_path copy/redesign, finish copy/layout/redesign, home hint/redesign, and sign_in copy/hint/redesign.

candidates.title: Path Choice Mascot Recommendation Hint
candidates.change: Display a hint below path options offering guidance on whether Instant Play or Custom Creator best fits the user.
candidates.why: Lessons learned show path selection hints consistently improved conversion in earlier tests, while choose_path drops 14.8% of users.

choose_path.hint: Select Instant Play for pre-made pets or Custom Creator to build your own companion.

guard.reason: Adds a helpful guidance hint to the choose path screen.

candidates.score_note: Path hints consistently win across tests (+3.8% historical lift).

candidates.title: Redesign Home Intro with Desktop Control Overview
candidates.change: Redesign the home_intro screen with a split layout showing interactive preview cards for essential desktop pet controls.
candidates.why: Support received 3 emails about desktop controls being unclear post-setup, and finish completion sits at only 64.8%.

guard.reason: 'home_intro.replace.home_welcome[1]': a choice_cards cannot do the home_welcome job (use ['animation', 'button', 'checklist', 'image', 'mascot', 'text'])

candidates.title: Pet Trait Selection Pre-Adoption Sub-Flow
candidates.change: Introduce a dedicated trait selection screen immediately following pet selection to let users pick personality traits.
candidates.why: Adoption stage has a heavy drop-off to 60.9% and 3 support emails reported custom pet creation issues.

new_trait_selection.headline: Pick Your Companion Traits
new_trait_selection.body: Select traits to customize your desktop pet behavior.

guard.reason: Changing pick_friend headline to personality customization removes its core job of choosing a pet.

candidates.title: Sign In Account Protection Spotlight Screen
candidates.change: Insert a spotlight screen prior to sign-in explaining how account linking prevents pet resets and loss.
candidates.why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or reset after signing in again, and sign_in drops 27.1% of users.

new_account_info.headline: Secure Your Pet Progress
new_account_info.body: Signing in links your pet safely to your account so you never lose progress.

guard.reason: screen 'new_account_info' is not part of onboarding (new screens are named new_..., and may not look like payment, account, sign-up or settings screens)

candidates.title: Reorder Sign In After Companion Selection
candidates.change: Move sign-in step to after adoption certificate screen so users pick and bond with their pet before signing in.
candidates.why: Sign-in currently drops 27.1% of users early before they have created or chosen their pet.

guard.reason: Reorders sign-in step after adoption certificate, which is allowed by rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Sign-in reordering showed minimal effect and requires structural flow changes.

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Preparation Progress Time Indicator
candidates.change: Enable visual progress bars and estimated completion time on the waiting screen while assets build.
candidates.why: The waiting screen has a high median duration of 201s and mean of 2336s, causing significant drop-off.

guard.reason: Adds progress bar and time estimate to the waiting screen during actual asset build.

candidates.score_note: Home wait_info changes have consistently failed to improve conversion across 3 tests.

candidates.title: Choose Path Instant Play Headline Focus
candidates.change: Update choose_path headline and body to emphasize fast zero-wait companion setup.
candidates.why: Improve decision speed and conversion on choose_path where 14.8% drop off.

choose_path.headline: How Would You Like to Meet Your Pet?
choose_path.body: Choose Instant Play to jump right in with a ready companion, or create a custom pet.

guard.reason: Updates choose path copy while retaining both Instant Play and Custom options.

candidates.score_note: Copy tweak on path choice is cheap with moderate positive history (+1.6%).

candidates.title: Home Intro Desktop System Tray Hint
candidates.change: Add a persistent hint on the final screen explaining how to interact with and hide the desktop pet from the system tray.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets noted user confusion on how to control or hide the pet once setup finishes.

home_intro.hint: Right-click your pet on the desktop or use the system tray icon to hide, feed, or adjust settings.

guard.reason: Adds an interaction hint to the home intro screen.

candidates.score_note: Backed by support tickets on a high-drop step, but finish hints historically show minimal lift.

candidates.title: Custom Pet Creation Photo Quality Hint
candidates.change: Add a photo quality hint on the photo upload screen recommending well-lit frontal photos.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported custom pet rendering failures or unexpected visuals.

upload_photos.hint: Upload clear, well-lit frontal photos for the best custom pet rendering results.

candidates.title: Sign In Account Sync Safety Hint
candidates.change: Display a hint on sign_in reassuring users that existing pet data automatically syncs across logins.
candidates.why: 8 support emails were received regarding lost or reset pets upon re-signing in.

sign_in.hint: Your pet and progress will automatically sync to this account upon sign-in.

guard.reason: Adds a data sync hint to the sign-in screen.

candidates.score_note: Strong evidence from both drop-off and 8 support emails; hint changes are low cost.

lessons_next: Predictions were overall too optimistic compared to noise-corrected results.
Path selection hints (choose_path, hint) consistently improved conversion, winning in 2 out of 3 tests.
Sign-in reordering (sign_in, reorder) achieved a win in round 8, though earlier tests showed no clear effect.
Adoption stage redesigns (adoption, redesign) across 3 tests failed to improve conversion, with larger redesigns hurting performance.
Home wait info (4 tests), finish hints (3 tests), finish notifications (2 tests), and home notifications (2 tests) showed no clear effect.

Evidence remains thin for categories with single tests or mixed outcomes, including adoption layout/new_screen, choose_path copy/layout/redesign, finish copy/layout/redesign, home hint/redesign, and sign_in copy/hint/redesign.
